desc: Upgrade your rifle with this RISE Armament BLITZ 3.5lb Drop-In Trigger w/Anti Walk Pins to get crisp, clean breaks with practically zero creep. These Rifle Triggers developed by the experts at RISE Armament feature the lightning-fast Quik-Klik reset that provides positive tactile and audible feedback so that you know when you're ready to fire another shot. Each RISE Armament BLITZ 3.5lb AR Trigger is built with the NoWay Take-up system that starts your trigger pull as soon as you start to pull the trigger so that you have full control over when you fire your rifle. This trigger is built with high-quality materials for maximum toughness, including the LiteMite Hammer that delivers reliable results without the weight other hammers bring. Easily install this RISE Armament BLITZ 3.5lb Single-Stage Trigger onto your weapon for improved performance at the range or on the hunting grounds.
